# Noobot v4.4.4

Changes since v4.4.3:

- Unify harness scenarios and strengthen message lifecycle, identity validation, and event acknowledgements.
- Centralize authoritative session timing and harden session storage upgrades and stale lock recovery.
- Load workspace directories on demand and refine the chat interface, navigation, and file previews.
- Improve desktop release initialization, reconnect regression coverage, and quality checks.
